extracted.name: Pancakes for Two (Taste of Home)
extracted.description: Great recipe for Pancakes for Two (Taste of Home).
instruction_lines: In a bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Combine buttermilk, oil, and egg; stir into dry ingredients and mix well. Fold in blueberries, if desired.
Pour batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto a lightly-greased hot griddle; turn when bubbles form on top of pancakes.
Cook till other side is golden-brown.
